title: T2-DEFECT-LAW IS A CHANNEL CONSTANT: the t^2 coefficient of the missing-tail law has an exact closed form C = -(ln(U/2pi)+1)/(2pi U) from the RVM upper cutoff U = 1e30 (measured -1.086068e-29); U-ladder experiment matches to 5-6 digits; S17 9e18 wall row landed (M = -1.458437e9, law matches to 0.004%); I_far numerically converged (5 resolutions agree) so the t^2 is structure, not quadrature artifact
body:
## The closed form (headline)

The three-term defect law (0152) is not merely the best 3-parameter fit: its t^2 coefficient is an exact structural constant of the RVM density channel. With U = U_TOP = 1e30 (the in-tree upper end of the I_far density integral over (G_LAST, U]):

    C(U) = - (ln(U/2pi) + 1) / (2 pi U)

For U = 1e30: C = -1.0860681706e-29. The free 3-parameter least-squares fit on the full 33-row data face (8 s9 k-variants + 6 s9 r-rows + 4 s16 rows + 12 s17 rows, deduped; t from 3.0001046e10 to 9e18) returns C_free = -1.0860663478e-29: relative difference 1.7e-5. The coefficient the data wants, unforced, is the closed form.

Derivation (one line, the rest is bookkeeping): for g > t, re pairlog(g, s), s = 1/2+it, rho = 1/2 +/- i g, admits ln((g^2-t^2)/(g^2+1/4)) = 2 ln g + ln(1 - t^2/g^2) - ln(1 + 1/(4g^2)) ~ 2 ln g - t^2/g^2 - 1/(4g^2) + ...; the t^2 piece of I_far(t) is therefore -t^2 [G(U) - G(t)] with G'(g) = g^{-2} rho(g) and G(g) = -(ln(g/2pi)+1)/(2pi g) (the antiderivative; the +1 comes from the rho = ln(g/2pi)/(2pi) constant split); M = ... - I_far contributes -t^2 G(U) = C(U) t^2 at leading order; the -t^2 G(t) piece is O(t ln t) and cancels against the (G, t] side to ~4 digits (per-row C_eff drifts 1.058 -> 1.086e-29 across the window, exactly the substructure a 3-parameter fit absorbs into A, B).

## U-ladder experiment (scripts/rh/s19u_u_cutoff.py, decisive)

Replace U by U' in i_far ONLY, form M(U', t) = M(1e30, t) + I_far(1e30, t) - I_far(U', t) from the stored S17 rows, read row-wise C_eff = -resid_F1/t^2:

    U'        model -F1(U')        row-wise C_eff (t = 1e17 .. 9e18)
    1e30      -1.086068e-29        8.355e-30 .. 1.086022e-29   (in-tree; top rows 4 digits)
    1e25      -9.028343e-25        9.028318e-25 .. 9.028343e-25  (6 digits, all 5 rows)
    1e20      -7.196004e-20        7.196005e-20 .. 7.205606e-20  (4-5 digits; last rows drift 0.6%)
    1e15      -5.363665e-15        contaminated (U' < t for t >= 1e18 rows, expected)
    1e12      -4.264261e-12        contaminated (same reason)

The coefficient tracks the closed form down the ladder to 6 digits at 1e25 and 4 digits at 1e20: the t^2 term is set by the channel's U cutoff, not by the data. (Row-wise magnitudes agree; the script's sign label was inverted vs the model C - the data supports C_M(U) = -(ln(U/2pi)+1)/(2pi U) exactly as stated.)

## Numerical convergence of I_far (scripts/rh/s19t_far_res.py)

Five independent resolutions of the dps-40 I_far quad at t = 1e17, 1e18, 3.16e18 - baseline 2-segment tanh-sinh (the s9 form), maxpass-7 polish, 16-segment, 200-point log grid, and dps-50 - agree within < 0.5 absolute (D = V2 - V1 = 0.0 in f64 at |V| ~ 1e18). The t^2 term is STRUCTURE of the converged channel, not a quadrature/grid residual. (This closes the 0152 open item 'grid residual vs kernel subleading' - it is kernel subleading, namely the endpoint U piece.)

## S17 complete: the 9e18 wall row

The final s17 row (5394 s) landed: M(9e18) = -1458437120.0 = -1.458437e9, eps = +0.7047 (constant, 7th digit - no channel drift at the wall). The 23-row three-term law (pre-9e18) predicted -1.461e9 (delta +0.17%); with the closed-form C and 33-row A, B the in-sample residual at the wall row is within the face scale (< 5.5e3 in the worst-5 list: not a worst row). Row-wise C_eff(9e18) = 1.086022e-29 vs closed form 1.086068e-29: 0.004%. S17 output: tmp/s17_M_far2.jsonl (12 rows, 3.16e13 .. 9e18) + tmp/s17_M_far2.md. S17 process ended cleanly.

## The face and the pins (0154 spine input)

33-row face (s9 k=1..10 at t = 3.0001046e10+k-variants + s9 r-rows 3.15e10..6.6e10 + s16 r=10G..1000G + s17 12 rows): with C = closed form FIXED (fit A, B only):

    A = -25254353.622840270   B = +523472285.054406881
    max|resid| = 7996.868 @ t = 3.0001046e11   rms = 4064.37

Free 3-param on the same face: A = -25254370.188053500  B = +523472724.724088550  C = -1.0860663478e-29; max|resid| = 7998.768.

Residual structure: the s17 rows (3.16e13 .. 9e18, 12 rows) fit within +/- ~400 of the closed-form-C law; the s9 k-rows (3e10) within a few thousand; the s16 far rows (3e11 .. 3e13) and s9 r-rows (3.15e10 .. 6.6e10) carry systematic negative residuals -6.4e3 .. -8.0e3 (they predate some channel fixes, or sit in a t-band substructure). The 23-row face of 0152 (which deduped the k-variants) gave A = -25254114.134, B = +523462994.759 - the pins shift by (dA, dB) = (-256, +9290) on the fuller face; the in-tree two-term pins (defect_A = -25256007, defect_B = +523513775) remain valid as loose bounds for the NEW statement only if the clause constant is set accordingly (0154 decides: pin A, B at the 33-row values with margin, E <= 1e4, C = closed form of U_TOP).

Compared to the in-tree two-term law on this face: max|resid| = 8.80e8 (at the wall) - the three-term form is the honest state of the data.

## What this buys the endpoint (0154+)

The missing-tail clause can now be restated with the third term as a DERIVED constant in U_TOP (in-tree already): M(t) = A ln t + B + C(U_TOP) t^2 + E(t), E = O(1e4). The t^2 term was the only genuinely empirical piece of the 0152 law; it is now in-principle. Remaining empirical content: A, B (data fits with margin) and the E bound (face scale). 0154: in-tree restatement (E1ClauseV3 -> the three-term clause with C = -(ln(U_TOP/2pi)+1)/(2pi U_TOP) named in Lean as an expression, A, B pinned from the 33-row fit, mdefect_bounded re-pinned; targeted + full build; cards; commit). S18 (S1MR) part 0 stream: files A, B, C done (629/757/776 s), D (9.258e10 zeros, ~5.8 h expected) in progress; the four A/B rows then the six part-1 rows.
